<$voicel(4,1)><$comeff(4,16)><$motion(4,805)><$facial(4,9)>*yaaawn*
I sure am sleepy. Where in tarnation am I, anyway?<$facial(4,1)>
<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,29)>Huh? Who are you? You from round these parts?

<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)>What’s that, now? The Pokémon and humans have all gone
’n’ disappeared someplace? <$voicel(4,4)><$comeff(4,6)>And you’re doin’ what ya
can to rebuild the towns and bring the Pokémon back?<$motion(0,652)>
<$voicel(4,9)><$comeff(4,5)><$motion(4,802)>Well I’ll be! Can’t believe all that’s been happenin’ while I
was asleep! <$voicel(4,8)><$motion(4,803)><$comeff(4,3)>Now that’s a wake-up call, I tell you what!

<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)>That expression on yer face is a bit lackadaisical, but the
way you’ve been livin’ is anythin’ but! <$voicel(4,8)><$comeff(4,9)>I think I like you!

<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,38)>You can count me as a friend from now on, young’un!
Don’t be a stranger now, ya hear?

<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,16)><$motion(4,666)><$facial(4,9)>*yaaawn*
Hm... I was hopin’ to teach ya a nice move, <$facial(4,1)>but fer the
life o’ me <$voicel(4,4)>I can’t remember what it was...
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,7)><$motion(4,807)>Mebbe I overslept? My head’s all fuzzy inside.

<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,14)>The best remedy fer a sleepy noggin is a nice hot meal!
That’d clear up my head in a jiffy, I bet!

<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,661)>Sorry fer the trouble, but do ya think you could bring me
<$voicel(4,4)><$comeff(4,6)><$cdef(27)>one pipin’ hot <$cdef(27)><$ifull(36)>?
<$voicel(4,5)><$motion(4,806)><$comeff(4,3)>If I can get my head thinkin’ straight again with a hot meal,
I can teach ya a move <$voicel(4,8)><$comeff(4,10)>that’s sure to be helpful!

<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,805)><$facial(4,14)>*sniff sniff*
I can smell it...waftin’ through the air...
I wager there’s a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(36)> <$voicel(4,4)><$facial(4,1)>somewhere on
this island!

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,27)>Hm? Well I’ll be! You’ve already got a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(36)> or
two on ya!

<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,805)>Sorry to trouble ya, but would ya mind sharin’ <$cdef(27)>one of ’em
with me?

<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,38)>Ya sure are kind, young’un! Hope ya don’t mind if I dig in
right away!

<$voicel(4,5)><$motion(4,17)>*munch munch munch*
Wowee! That’s hot as all get out! Jus’ gotta blow on it a
li’l bit... There we go! *munch munch*

<$voicel(4,9)><$comeff(4,8)><$motion(4,19)>Ahhh! So hot! Jus’ how I like it! Ya won’t hear me talkin’
about bein’ drowsy anymore! That’s the truth!
<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,50)>And I’ve jus’ remembered the move I wanted to teach ya
as well!

<$voicel(4,6)><$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,661)>The move’s called <$cdef(27)>Waterfall!
<$voicel(4,3)><$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,805)>Ya sometimes come across waterfalls when you’re usin’
<$cdef(27)><$sklfull(10)> to swim around, don’tcha?

<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,29)>Do ya think you could bring me <$cdef(27)>one pipin’ hot
<$cdef(27)><$ifull(36)>?
<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,38)>If I can get my head thinkin’ straight again with a hot meal,
I can teach ya a move that’s sure to be helpful!

<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,805)><$facial(4,14)>*sniff sniff*
I can smell it...waftin’ through the air...
I wager there’s a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(36)> <$voicel(4,4)><$facial(4,1)>somewhere on
this island!

<$voicel(4,9)><$emotion(4,27)>Ah-ha! That’s it! That’s a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(36)> if ever I saw one!
<$voicel(4,8)><$emotion(4,38)>Hope ya don’t mind if I dig in right away!

<$voicel(4,5)><$motion(4,17)>*munch munch munch*
Wowee! That’s hot as all get out! Jus’ gotta blow on it a
li’l bit... There we go! *munch munch*

<$voicel(4,9)><$comeff(4,8)><$motion(4,19)>Ahhh! So hot! Jus’ how I like it! Ya won’t hear me talkin’
about bein’ drowsy anymore! That’s the truth!
<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,50)>And I’ve jus’ remembered the move I wanted to teach ya
as well!

<$voicel(4,6)><$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,661)>The move’s called <$cdef(27)>Waterfall!
<$voicel(4,3)><$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,805)>Ya sometimes come across waterfalls when you’re usin’
<$cdef(27)><$sklfull(10)> to swim around, don’tcha?

<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,29)>What’s that, now? Ya don’t know how to swim?
<$voicel(4,3)><$comeff(4,7)><$motion(4,802)>Well, that jus’ won’t do. Can’t master <$cdef(27)>Waterfall without a
li’l swimmin’!

<$voicel(4,7)><$comeff(4,20)><$motion(4,801)>But you’re a <$cdef(27)>Ditto, after all! I’ll bet ya could jus’
<$voicel(4,6)><$motion(4,805)><$cdef(27)><$spwfull(36)> into a Pokémon who can swim!

<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,10)><$motion(4,661)>If ya go to a nice li’l harbor town surrounded by water, I
bet you’ll run into a Pokémon who can use <$cdef(27)><$sklfull(10)>.
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,803)>Once you’ve figured out how to <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(36)> into a
Pokémon like that, you come on back to me, ya hear?
<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,1)>Then I can teach ya how to use <$cdef(27)>Waterfall!

<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,14)>Search a harbor town someplace fer a Pokémon who can
use <$cdef(27)><$sklfull(10)>.
<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,49)>Once ya figure out how to <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(36)> into a Pokémon
like that, I can teach ya how to use <$cdef(27)>Waterfall!

<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,14)>Then all you gotta do is jus’ swim up to one of ’em, give
the water upstream a good strong glare...
<$voicel(4,10)><$emotion(4,53)>Then psyche yerself up and go, go, GO! <$voicel(4,10)><$comeff(4,10)><$motionoff(4,804)>As long as ya got
guts, you’ll make it to the top!

You learned <$cdef(27)>Waterfall! Press <$keyicon(6)> in front of a waterfall
while <$cdef(27)><$sklfull(10)>ing!

<$voicel(4,7)><$comeff(4,9)><$motion(4,661)>If ya can master <$cdef(27)>Waterfall, it’ll surely be useful while
you’re explorin’!

<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,1)>So you’ve gone and learned <$cdef(27)><$sklfull(10)>, have ya? Great! All
right then—I’m ready to teach ya <$cdef(27)>Waterfall, as promised!
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,805)>First, look fer a waterfall as you’re <$cdef(27)><$sklfull(10)>in’ </color>about...

<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,14)>Then all you’ve gotta do is jus’ swim up to it with poise!
Give the water upstream a good strong glare! And then
<$voicel(4,10)><$emotion(4,53)>psyche yerself up and go, go, GO!
<$voicel(4,10)><$comeff(4,10)><$motionoff(4,804)>So long as you’ve got guts, you’ll make it to the top!

while <$cdef(27)><$sklfull(10)>ing!

<$voicel(4,7)><$comeff(4,9)><$motion(4,661)>If ya can master <$cdef(27)>Waterfall, it’ll surely be useful while
